brief: A three-storey cabinet with at least three drawers.

requirements.evidence: Three half-north hex bases stacked at cell (0,0) on levels 0, 1 and 2 (piece:0,0,0, piece:0,0,1, piece:0,0,2), joined by snaps; check_build reports no issues and meshClash clear.
Three drawers added, one per storey on the cut face of each half base (drawer:0#0,0#cut, drawer:1#0,0#cut, drawer:2#0,0#cut).

finish.summary: Built a three-storey cabinet from a single stack of three half-north hex bases with one drawer on each storey, then closed the open faces with solid caps and locked the joints. check_build is clean (no issues, meshClash clear). No props were added since the brief concerns structure. Material suitability (strength, finish) is not checked by the configurator.

Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
